name: Higgsfield / Freepik (multi-model)
length_note: Pick the length shown (the smallest the model sells that holds the line). The app keeps the clip's real length and cuts a speaking shot 0.3 s after its last word.

modes.keyframe: Image to video: image 1 (the keyframe) as the start frame; the others as references.
modes.references: Reference images: attach them in this order.

closing: No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text.
prompt_notes: For speech in French (or any language but English and Chinese) pick Veo 3.1 or Seedance 2.0, never Kling 3.0: Kling speaks English and Chinese only.
Attach the reference images in the order listed: the prompt names them by their number.
The spoken line stays in quotes, in the story's language: do not translate it.
where_to_paste: Higgsfield → Video → pick the model shown → upload the reference images in order → {aspect} → paste the prompt → Generate. Download the take you like as MP4.

credits.note: Credits per clip depend on the model and your plan: check the model's price in Higgsfield before generating.
